name: Scratchpad
description: A small to-do list for each workspace, in the right sidebar. It lives in a plain Markdown file in a synced folder, so your agents can read and edit it too.

settings.title: Scratch folder
settings.description: Where the lists live: one Markdown file per workspace, in a folder per host. Point it at a folder Syncthing (or similar) shares with your servers so agents there edit the same lists.
